mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.member_id, m.phone, o.product_id, o.product_name, p.category_id, c.category_name, c.cover_url as series_cover_url, o.currency, o.price, ifnull(o.quantity, 1) as quantity, o.daily_rebate, o.duration_days, o.remaining_days, o.last_rebate_date, o.withdraw_required, o.status, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.remark from biz_order o left join biz_member m on m.member_id = o.member_id left join biz_product p on p.product_id = o.product_id left join biz_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_order where member_id = #{memberId}
select ifnull(sum(ifnull(quantity, 1)), 0) from biz_order where member_id = #{memberId} and product_id = #{productId}
select count(1) from biz_order where member_id = #{memberId} and withdraw_required = '1' and currency = #{currency}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_order ( order_no, member_id, product_id, product_name, currency, price, quantity, daily_rebate, duration_days, remaining_days, last_rebate_date, withdraw_required, status, create_time ) values ( #{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{currency}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{dailyRebate}, #{durationDays}, #{remainingDays}, #{lastRebateDate}, #{withdrawRequired}, #{status}, sysdate() )
